title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
lede: S&P Global Ratings is reviewing Nvidia's AA credit rating, citing weak executive oversight, no succession plan and heavy reliance on CEO Jensen Huang after his ouster and return.

points: S&P expects to finish the review within 90 days and could lower the rating one notch, to AA-.
Nvidia would stay investment grade, but a cut could raise what it pays to borrow.
Because Nvidia backstops neoclouds and other infrastructure firms with weaker credit, their debt could get costlier or need more collateral.
Nvidia is arranging $500 billion in AI infrastructure financing with six institutions, guaranteeing 25% under the original terms, and lenders were already pressing for more.

sections.text: Neoclouds that lean on Nvidia's backing for their debt could face higher costs or collateral demands, which matters to anyone renting GPU compute from them.
